title: Servana → Citrus R&E common payload envelope (Plan §58B.2, schema_version 1)
description: Fields present in EVERY Servana outbound event payload. Referenced by each event schema; not emitted on its own.

product_code.description: R&E-assigned product code for Servana. NOT pinned at Phase 21R-A (assumed 'SRV'; see contract-pins.md, REM-RE-002).

merchant_public_id.description: Servana merchant ULID = R&E source_tenant_id. The ONLY merchant identifier that ever crosses the boundary; internal sequential ids are forbidden (§58B.2).

event_id.description: ULID generated once at outbox insert; stable across every retry (§9 rule 22).

occurred_at.description: BUSINESS time of the source fact (UTC, ISO-8601 Zulu). The signing timestamp is delivery time and is a header, not a payload field (§58B.5 R-21).

sequence_no.description: Per-merchant monotonic ordering key. R&E workers partition by merchant.
